_meta.openai/widgetDescription: A list of offers across shops with copy buttons, end dates and links.

description: Live offers PriceDash lists across UK shops, one per shop, up to five: the newest, those ending within five days, those ending today, or those in one product category.

category.description: A PriceDash product category, e.g. 'Electricals', 'Fashion', 'Holidays & Travel'. Omit for every category.

filter.description: newest: most recently added; ending-soon: ending within five days; today-only: ending today. Ignored when a category is given.

name: browse-deals

hasMore.description: True when the page has more offers than are listed

checkedDate.description: The day PriceDash last read the offer at source, when within the last 30 days

code.description: The voucher code to enter at checkout, when the offer has one

expiryDate.description: When the offer ends, if it has an end date

linkUrl.description: PriceDash's link to the offer at the shop

siteUrl.description: The PriceDash page with every offer

suggestions.description: Shop or category names to try when nothing matched

title.description: The shop, or the list, the offers are for

title: Browse UK offers
